wish: someone should make a video player that steps backward frame by frame
spec:
Opens a video from your device and steps it forward or backward one frame (or ten) at a time, showing frame number and time.
Tap -1/+1/-10/+10, drag the scrubber, type a frame, or use arrow keys (shift for 10); frame rate is auto-detected or set by hand.
It does not upload, edit, or export the video; it plays only formats your browser can decode.
notes: CSP media-src adds blob: so a locally opened file can play; nothing leaves the device. Includes a 3 kB inline sample clip (12 fps test pattern) so it works before a file is chosen.
